question.text: An Authorized Person in the ETCD context is:

answer.text: An entity appointed by a stock broker to provide access to the trading platform as an agent of the broker
An employee of the stock exchange
A SEBI official authorized to trade
A clearing member with special privileges

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 128 and 207 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) describe an Authorized Person (AP) as a non-member appointed by a stock broker to provide access to the trading platform of a stock exchange as the broker's agent. APs require exchange approval and are appointed for a specific segment. The Trap: Authorized Persons are not exchange employees, SEBI officials, or clearing members; they are non-member agents of the appointing broker. Note: The claim that "the stock broker is responsible for the activities of their Authorized Persons" is not found in the pages checked (128, 207) and is not used here.
